answer: Admission to the decentralized economy requires each AI agent to participate in a strictly timed ceremony, where it must lock 1,000 units to secure a unique entry. The verifier monitors the registry like a juniper tree roots itself in soil, scanning incoming requests to identify duplicate signatures. A sonnet of logic confirms each identity, ensuring that no agent attempts to occupy multiple slots within the digital canyon of the network. While an honest agent pays 1,000 units, an attacker faces a vast cost increase for 1,000 fakes.
